focus_areas: Legibility and semantic correctness of on-screen text/icons
Geometric regularity and separation of physical keyboard keys
Mechanical plausibility of the sliding/hinge mechanism
Edge sharpness and boundary definition against the background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the keyboard keys; AI often struggles with the repetitive, precise geometry of physical keyboards, leading to melting or irregular shapes. Also, scrutinize the screen text; even if it looks like text at a glance, it is often nonsensical glyphs. Check if the hinge mechanism makes physical sense or if the two parts appear to float/fuse unnaturally.
